output.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_with_discount_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.discount_amount > 0
output.explanation: Counts distinct orders dated in calendar 2025 (any status, so no is_revenue filter) whose order-level discount_amount is greater than zero. Discount is taken from fct_orders.discount_amount, which aggregates the line-level discounts.
